messages:
Alex: Quick announcement — deployment rhythm update. Starting next Tue (2026-04-07) we move to a Tue/Thu canary cadence for the core release train. Rationale: smooth out peak load and reduce bursty infra churn. Details below.

Maria: Sounds good. What are the actual windows + timezone?

Alex: Canary windows = 09:00–11:00 PT on Tue and Thu. Full rollout target at 13:00 PT if canaries are green. Default canary traffic = 15%

Sophie: @Alex are we keeping the 2-hour pre-check for schema changes? I use that for migrations.

Alex: Yes — pre-check 08:00–09:00 PT. If a migration exceeds the safe threshold follow the updated backfill policy.

Raj: Backfill policy where is that? link?

Alex: Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/backfill-policy (internal). TL;DR:
- If per-request migration cost >5s, schedule in a reserved maintenance slot and disable canary.
- Otherwise run online backfill via batch workers with --backfill-safe and rate limits.
- All backfills must be registered in the release tracker.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release/rhythm-update by Alex at 2026-04-07T09:00:00Z — canary 15% for 2h

Tim: For Dedicated customers, will we send tenant-level notices?

Maria: Yes — Customer comms plan: 72h tenant email + post to #customer-communications 24h before. Ops will follow up for any customers requesting blackout windows.

Sophie: Any change to rollback criteria? we had the 3xx spike threshold before.

Alex: Rollback thresholds remain: error rate +50% over baseline OR latency P95 > 2x baseline OR explicit customer-impact flag. New: "backfill safety hold" — if a backfill job is in flight the rollout auto-pauses to avoid competing pressure.

release-council: Quick FYI — execs approved a temporary freeze option for emergency security patches during these windows. Policy doc link will be posted.

Alex: Please ack in-thread if you own any late-breaking changes this sprint. If we don't get an ack, we'll defer changes to the next cycle. :point_up:

Maria: Ack — gating a small infra tweak, coordinating with Sophie.

Sophie: Ack

Raj: Ack — DB vacuum scheduled into the maintenance slot per policy.

Alex: Thanks all. We'll publish the official changelog, calendar invites, and the short checklist for release engineers. Ping me for exceptions. :thumbsup:
